messages:
maria: Hey team — pushed fixes for lint + the e2e flake on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/623. Addressed all review comments, split the commits and added a unit test. PTAL when you have a sec.

alex: Quick Q: did you revert the backoff tweak or keep it? I skimmed the diff and couldn't spot the final state.

maria: Kept the tweak but made it configurable (runtime.backoff.enabled). Added a tiny test asserting default=true. See the last commit.

sam: Left one tiny inline nit about a log message level — please change debug -> info and squash that debug/print commit. Otherwise looks good.

maria: Done — squashed and updated to INFO, pushed force. Thanks for catching that.

ci-bot: CI: unit tests ✅, e2e ✅, lint ✅ — all checks passed.

jordan: pulled and ran a quick smoke locally, no flake on my machine. LGTM.

alex: Verified tests as well, approving. @maria I can take the 19:00 PST canary slot if that helps.

sam: +1 from me too.

maria: Awesome — scheduling canary at 19:00 PST, will run pre-canary smoke and merge after. I’ll post results here. :thumbsup:
